name: broadcast
description: SaaS de Broadcast — monorepo com frontend (Vite/React) e backend (Firebase Cloud Functions)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-broadcast --only firestore "node --test tests/scheduled.messages.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
